params.1273: Make a rune crossbow yourself, from scratch, performing each step within either Witchaven or Yanille.
params.1274: You must perform each of the following steps to complete this Task:
params.1275: Fletch yew logs into a stock and smith a rune bar into crossbow limbs.
params.1276: Make sinew and spin it into a crossbow string.
params.1292: This Elite Task is part of the Ardougne set.
